record.original_question: Characterize new binary cyclic codes with two zeros that are optimal, or at least have minimum distance five, beyond the special families already known to the chapter.

evidence.quote: To characterize new cyclic codes with two zeros which are optimal, even not optimal but with minimum distance five, remains a hard open problem.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $m \geq 3$ be an integer and let $\alpha$ be a primitive element of the finite field $\mathbb{F}_{2^m}$. For an integer $i$, let $M_i(x) \in \mathbb{F}_2[x]$ denote the minimal polynomial of $\alpha^i$ over $\mathbb{F}_2$. For a pair of integers $1 \le i < j \le 2^m-2$ such that $\alpha^i$ and $\alpha^j$ lie in distinct 2-cyclotomic cosets modulo $2^m-1$, consider the binary cyclic code $\mathcal{C}_{i,j}$ of length $n = 2^m-1$ defined as the cyclic code whose generator polynomial is $M_i(x) M_j(x)$; equivalently, $\mathcal{C}_{i,j}$ has the two zeros $\alpha^i$ and $\alpha^j$ (together with their conjugates). Such a code is called a binary cyclic code with two zeros.

Problem: Characterize, beyond the currently known special families, all pairs $(i,j)$ (equivalently, all binary cyclic codes with two zeros) for which the resulting code $\mathcal{C}_{i,j}$ either
(a) is distance-optimal among binary linear codes of length $n$ and the same dimension, or
(b) has minimum distance at least $5$.

In particular, describe new infinite families of such pairs $(i,j)$ (for $m$ ranging over infinitely many values) that yield codes satisfying (a) or (b), and that are not equivalent to previously known constructions.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem remains an active area of research. Several new families of binary cyclic codes with two zeros and good minimum distance (including distance-optimal codes) have been constructed in recent years, but a complete characterization is not available, and the problem is generally still regarded as a hard open problem.

status_evidence.snippet: A class of binary cyclic codes with two nonzeros having parameters [2^m-1, 2^m-m-9, 4] which are distance-optimal with respect to the Sphere Packing bound.
status_evidence.claim: New distance-optimal binary cyclic codes with two zeros have been constructed, indicating partial progress.

status_evidence.snippet: Five infinite families of binary cyclic codes with good parameters are constructed.
